_comment: How each (emulator, core) row RetroBat's es_systems.cfg offers is joined to the retrobios source that describes the firmware its code reads. A row is first looked up by the core name each retrobios profile declares (by the core for libretro, by the emulator otherwise); an entry under 'emulators' replaces that lookup, keyed by 'emulator/core' or 'emulator/*'. Its value is {'profiles': [...]} naming retrobios emulator profiles, {'bizhawk': true} for BizHawk's FirmwareDatabase.cs, or {'none': '<why>'} for a row no retrobios source describes. A row that resolves to nothing and has no entry fails tools/vendor-retrobios.py and reference/verify.py, so coverage never shrinks silently. Hand-maintained; the vendored sources are described in reference/README.md.

daphne/daphne.none: retrobios's daphne profile names no file

gemrb/gemrb.none: a game engine; reads game data, not firmware

kega-fusion/*.none: retrobios has no Kega Fusion profile; Fusion.ini names bios_U.sms, bios_E.sms and bios_J.sms (#533)

libretro/mame2014.none: retrobios profiles mame2010 and mame2015 but not mame2014

mugen/mugen.none: a game engine; reads game data, not firmware

pinballfx/*.none: a store-bought PC game; reads no firmware

psxmame/mame.none: retrobios has no profile for the ZiNc build RetroBat ships

xemu-chihiro/chihiro.none: retrobios's xemu profile covers the Xbox, not the Chihiro

zaccariapinball/*.none: a store-bought PC game; reads no firmware

zquestclassic/zc255.none: a game engine; reads game data, not firmware
